description: This file defines the server-side load function for the invoices list page in a SvelteKit project. It fetches invoice data from a Django backend API, processes filters and pagination parameters from the URL, and transforms the response for frontend consumption.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and processes invoice data from the backend API, handling filters, pagination, and error cases.

parameters.name: { url, locals, cookies }
parameters.description: Object containing URL, local context, and cookies for the request.

methods.returns: An object containing processed invoice data, pagination info, and filters.
